title: On Mounting the steps with a load
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：mount　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mount 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the clerk ① mounted the steps with a load without complaint, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② mounts the steps with a load with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ mount the steps with a load at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ mounted the steps with a load before — a line in the file for May 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Mounting the steps with a load without complaint, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ mount the old map on cloth with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Mount the old map on cloth at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ mounts the old map on cloth without complaint every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ mounted the steps with a load again when nobody else would.

⑩ To mount the steps with a load, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody mounts the steps with a load with great care again and somebody must mount the steps with a load without complaint all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。

B. v. 登上（一般现在 mounts the steps with a load：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 登上（不定式 to mount the steps with a load：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 登上（过去完成时 had mounted the steps with a load：1949 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 登上（动名词 mounting the steps with a load 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 裱贴（mount the old map on cloth：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去裱贴把那张旧地图裱在布上）

H. v. 登上（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 mounts the old map on cloth，而母亲又一次 mounted the steps with a load）

mount 意为“登上”，自那以后书记员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 mounts。

mount 意为“裱贴”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去裱贴把那张旧地图裱在布上”，should ever 之后用原形 mount the old map on cloth。
mount 意为“裱贴”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻裱贴把那张旧地图裱在布上（mount the old map on cloth at once），以后再也不要提起。

mount 意为“登上”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要登上带着行李登上台阶，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mount 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the clerk mounted the steps with a load without complaint, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk mounts the steps with a load with great care whenever the office asks.
Mounting the steps with a load without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever mount the old map on cloth with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office mounts the old map on cloth without complaint every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother mounted the steps with a load again, and the office remembered that half.
